evidence.sourceTitle: ESPIRE (Interactive Evaluation Environment) official release documentation
evidence.statement: The official driver obtains observations, invokes client.move_to, records execution results and refreshes observations before the next movement. This directly exposes action-conditioned transitions, resolving the prior uncertainty about whether evaluation was static only.
